name: Produce Testable Ad Creative
summary: Create platform-fit ad variants whose hypotheses and claims can be reviewed and measured.
description: Produce ad concepts and copy variants tied to distinct audience insights, formats, claims, and measurement hypotheses. Use when paid campaigns need new creative, disciplined iteration from performance evidence, or a reviewable creative testing matrix.
risk_reason: This skill creates platform-fit ad variants whose hypotheses and claims can be reviewed and measured; it does not generate large batches whose differences cannot produce interpretable learning.
refuses: It does not fabricate testimonials, performance numbers, scarcity, endorsements, or product capabilities.
It does not evade advertising policies or disguise regulated, discriminatory, or deceptive targeting.
It does not generate large batches whose differences cannot produce interpretable learning.

operational.latency_reason: The skill creates platform-fit ad variants whose hypotheses and claims can be reviewed and measured, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
